### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, touching **6** documentable anchor(s).

**5** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/data-modeling/drivers.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/datasources (route, a path literal in a comment in Serve; a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/external-datasources.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/datasources (route, a path literal in a comment in Serve; a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/datasources (route, a path literal in a comment in Serve; a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/plugins/index.mdx`  _(via http.server (literal, a string literal in Serve; a string literal in createUnknownHostnameGuardPlugin))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/error-handling.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/datasources (route, a path literal in a comment in Serve; a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_

⛔ **3** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/datasources (route, a path literal in a comment in Serve; a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/datasources (route, a path literal in a comment in Serve; a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/datasources (route, a path literal in a comment in Serve; a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `os serve (command, 33 pages)`, `/api/v1 (route, 96 pages)`
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **29** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c1c0a90942ff702ee6a5b40d0382808f6b2b154c` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `feccac428fa0f192aedc6b65f3c4c4188bfeddbc` — the merge of head `6c33626a8df327db1be7cdf94c11ca8508fc5c87` into base `c1c0a90942ff702ee6a5b40d0382808f6b2b154c`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin feccac428fa0f192aedc6b65f3c4c4188bfeddbc && git checkout feccac428fa0f192aedc6b65f3c4c4188bfeddbc
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin c1c0a90942ff702ee6a5b40d0382808f6b2b154c 6c33626a8df327db1be7cdf94c11ca8508fc5c87 && git checkout -B drift-repro c1c0a90942ff702ee6a5b40d0382808f6b2b154c && git merge --no-ff 6c33626a8df327db1be7cdf94c11ca8508fc5c87

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c1c0a90942ff702ee6a5b40d0382808f6b2b154c
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs c1c0a90942ff702ee6a5b40d0382808f6b2b154c` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:cli` seat 1 · `os-sales` · session `session_01BVm1pAXVXQ3PjC42j1kPFf` · 2026-10-17T03:08Z

Head `6c33626a8`. This is the seat's review of record for #24022 (claim `6228120195`, amendment `6228552643`), read against GitHub and `origin/main`, ⛔ not against the reports (`6228522842` and the patch-round report).

- **Form:** draft → `main`. The first line is `Fixes #24022`, the body's only closing keyword (scanned after the seat's body edit). `Clause-②: no` is line-initial and matches the claim.
- **Premise, measured:** `readComposedHttpServer`'s docblock on `origin/main` (`serve.ts`, above `:546`) records that `getService` throws on an unregistered name; the PR pins it on a real `ObjectKernel`. Both producers of the `http-server` alias also register `http.server`, the same instance (`plugin-hono-server/src/hono-plugin.ts` `:286` / `:289`; `qa/http-conformance/src/node-plugin.ts` `:40` / `:41`). So dropping the alias read changes no mount.
- **Surface:** 6 files, all inside the claim plus amendment. The `serve.ts` hunks are the datasource-admin plugin moving into `createDatasourceAdminRoutesPlugin` (same name, version, `optionalDependencies`) and the guard's one-line read. `readComposedHttpServer` is unchanged.
  - Published surface: the `@objectstack/cli` entry re-exports only `default as ServeCommand` from `serve.js` (`packages/cli/src/index.ts:19`). The new named export is not reachable from any entry in `package.json` `exports`, so `Clause-②: no` stands.
- **Family:** on `origin/main` the seat's grep (`getService?.('http[.-]server') ??`, non-test `packages/**/*.ts`) hits 3 lines: `readComposedHttpServer` itself, and this PR's two plugins. After this PR only the first remains (the dev's reading on the head).
- **Changeset** (one `@objectstack/cli` patch), sentence by sentence against the diff:
  - "no longer reports an ordering fault for the datasource admin routes or for the unknown-hostname guard": both hunks. ✓
  - "Each now prints its own degrade line": both strings match the `init` bodies. ✓
  - "Both plugins now read only the canonical `http.server` service": `readComposedHttpServer` reads `http.server` only. ✓
  - "Their old fallback … never ran": the throw comes before the `??`. ✓
- **Tests:** both ablations recorded with both legs.
  - Round 1, the datasource plugin, rebuilt: unit 1 failed, integration 2 failed, each showing the card's exact line.
  - Round 2, the guard, from source: 2 failed.
  - The controls stayed green in both. The refusal control asserts `404` and `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_FOUND`.
- **Gates, pinned to `6c33626a8`:** `Lint & Repo Gates` success; `TypeScript Type Check` success; the rest success or skipped. At this record, the four checks that read the PR body are re-running after the seat's body edit. Landing waits for every check on the head to be green.
- **Accepted deviations:**
  - (a) The branch is 3 commits behind `main`. `merge-tree` is clean, and none of them touches `packages/cli`; the merge ref is CI's reading.
  - (b) The guard ablation ran without a rebuild, because its test imports `./serve.js` from source.
  - (c) The seat wrote the patch-round edits into the PR body from the dev's report: a read-modify-write of the live body, 10,455 bytes read back identical.
- **Out of scope:** the sibling-plugin finding was fixed in place under the amendment, so none is open. The `packages/runtime/README.md` alias line is docs drift: noted, not filed. The docs-drift bot's pages: no page under `content/docs` or `apps/docs` quotes any of the changed log lines (0 hits; the control `api/v1/datasources` hits `external-datasources.mdx` twice).
- **Landing:** not governed (`check-governed-merges --pr 24132`: 0 of 6 paths, 446 lines ≤ 3000). The PR goes ready with auto-merge armed once every check on the head is green.
